name: zc_fire_look

tests.name: both fire skins were in frame and readable
there is fire on both fire skins, and it is lit

detail.note: at wl.Look.FireGain 0.12 this read 0.010 and the fire was invisible in the photograph; the gain was swept to 1.6 in one session by zc_fire_gain_sweep.

tests.name: the fire is never the same twice -- it flickers
the fire keeps its colour instead of washing to white

detail.note: at the authored strength 88% of Arden's flame band was over white and its ember orange was gone -- which is what an additive material does with a value of 1,320. This is the clause that keeps the gain honest.
